name: מבחן ההשוואה – התכנסות של שלושה טורים חיוביים (באנגלית)
questiontext:
The comparison test: If \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n, \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} b_n\) are such that \(b_n \ge a_n \ge 0\)  for all but finitely many values of \(n\). Then

  • if \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} b_n\) converges then so does \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\).
  • if \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} a_n\) diverges then so does \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} b_n\).

For example consider the series \(\sum_{n=3}^{\infty} \frac{3}{\sqrt{n-2}}\). Since \(0 \le 3 n^{-1/2} \le  \frac{3}{\sqrt{n-2}} \) and since the series \( \sum_{n=3}^{\infty} 3 n^{-1/2} \) diverges, say by the integral test. We conclude that the given series diverges.
